trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Identified the rollback target**: Deploy history showed v2.3.1 (latest) unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout completed and verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the health check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.
